decision: No refactor required. The simulation owns collision, damage and turn flow; LaserFenceLinkResolver remains the shared pairing rule used by presentation and runtime.
testDiffReview: The focused test remains a public combat scenario. It still requires two real shots, observes HP and active team state, and asserts that a consumed link cannot deal a second hit.
remainingCoverage: Ally safety and out-of-range pairs are documented acceptance cases but need their own behavior tests before laser_fence can be reported fully verified.
